newsitem.title: CHINA: Insurer John Hancock opens China office.
newsitem.headline: Insurer John Hancock opens China office.

text.p: John Hancock Mutual Life Insurance Co, the largest life insurance company in the United States, has opened its third office in China, the Xinhua news agency said.
The insurance company opened a representative office in the northern city of Tianjin following openings in Shanghai and Beijing, Xinhua said late on Thursday.

The company hoped to establish a joint venture life insurance company in China, a company official said, adding that the company invested $41.5 million in China in the first half of 1996. He gave no further details.
